output:
I'll start by reading the policy and input files.

I'll pull the adjustment history for the orders, starting with the first page of all adjustments.

Per-order filtering works. I'll fetch the remaining pages for all 12 orders (up to 4 pages each).

Analysis is complete. Releases come first so the stock returns to `main`, then reservations. First batch:

Next batch: SO-5506 (release seven skus), SO-5508 and SO-5509 releases.

Releases are done. Now the reservations.

My last call had malformed arguments and didn't run. I'll reissue it.

All 12 orders in `open-orders.csv` now hold the reservations the policy calls for. I wrote `/app/kit-reservations.csv` with 83 data rows and `/app/STATUS.json` with status `success`. I didn't re-query the ledger after posting. The adjustments all returned success, and I checked the CSV's line count and that the JSON parses.

All postings were `transfer` pairs with the order id as reference. Releases went first, then reservations.

| Order | Change |
|---|---|
| SO-5501 | Released 1 of CP-202. The picked CP-213 substitute counts toward CP-202. |
| SO-5502 | Used KT-10 revision B, since the order date is 09-03. Reserved 2 each of CP-206 and CP-212, and released the 2 CP-211 held from revision A. |
| SO-5503 | KT-10 inside KT-30 uses revision B. Reserved 2 each of CP-201 to CP-206 and CP-212, and released 2 of CP-216, which was picked from the shelf. |
| SO-5504 | Reserved 2 of CP-207 and 1 of CP-208, and released 1 of CP-204. The CP-218 pick counts toward CP-204 because the order's tree holds KT-20. |
| SO-5505 | The amended KT-20 quantity is 2. Released 2 of CP-207, 1 of CP-208 and 1 of CP-204. |
| SO-5506 | The KT-10 line is cancelled. Released 2 each of CP-201 to CP-206 and CP-212, and kept the 2 CP-207 from the second line. |
| SO-5507 | Reserved 1 of CP-204. The CP-218 pick counts toward nothing, because this order has no KT-20. |
| SO-5508 | The amended KT-20 quantity is 2. CP-207 was over-picked, so I released its remaining 3. Released 2 each of CP-208 and CP-204. |
| SO-5509 | Released 1 of CP-203, because the CP-214 pick at ratio 2 covers 1 unit. |
| SO-5512 | Used KT-20 revision B and reserved 1 of CP-210. |
| SO-5510, SO-5511 | Already correct, so no changes. |

Only orders in `open-orders.csv` were touched, and the only stock moved was between `main` and `reserved`.
